The Cadillac V-16 of 1930 was America's ultimate luxury car: a 7.4-liter sixteen-cylinder engine of turbine smoothness, in bodies by Fleetwood and Fisher. About 4,076 were built across two generations, the finest American cars of the Classic Era. It was Cadillac's answer to Duesenberg and Packard. Baseline facts: American luxury car 1930-1940; ~4,076 built by Cadillac; 7.4L V16..
